title: Perfect tour
text: Perfect tour around the city with a really nice guide who told us do many interesting fasts and funny stories
author: idunklettel

title: Well worth going. Highly recommend!
text: Albert is a great guide. He is well informed and goes in depth about the topic of our tour. He is patient and willing to answer questions if you miss something he said. Well worth the time and money.
author: Russell_P

title: Good Gaudi overview and tour of Barcelona
text: Excellent walking tour that covers a lot Gaudi works. Great overview of the Sagrada Família and other locales. Carlos had an excellent understanding of Gaudi’s work and Barcelona’s history. Great value and a good alternative if the tickets for the Basílica are not available
author: LisaM_Trvlr

title: Guide was very...
text: Guide was very knowledgeable of Barcelona history. Guide was very personal in ensuring the group stayed together and was very open to questions the group had. Would highly recommend for your guided tour.
author: Gabriel_G

title: Albert = Awesome!
text: Albert is awesome & approachable! His passion for his home city is contagious. I would request him again for certain.
author: davebA3796OW

title: Great way to see all the...
text: Great way to see all the Gaudi exteriors and learn about the history  and architecture of the city. Our local guide Albert was very knowledgeable and answered all of our questions. Highly recommend!

title: Great Tour!
text:
It’s very good. We learned a lot, and our brains were hurting afterwards.
Her knowledge is extensive. I love that she made sure everyone understood before we moved on.
Highly recommend.
author: Mary_A

title: Book a tour with Albert!!
text: Albert was a great guide!! He shared a lot of fun facts about Barcelona, on top of explaining all there is to know about the specific sites we visited. He also made it all fun and very enjoyable. The tour is super well thought out (Sagrada Familia, Casa Batllo, Casa Mila, Gothic quarter and medieval city) and allowed us to see a lot of the places one needs to see in Barcelona in a fair amount of time (3 hours).
author: S7789ZDayah

title: 10 out of 10
text: Albert so fantastic! So knowledgeable, friendly, and has family ties to the area. Very easy to understand and kept us engaged and entertained. He even sent a multi-page document of local recommendations at the end. Couldn’t be better!
author: Brennah_W

title: Great Great Great
text: Tour guide was fantastic.  Very knowledgeable and friendly and adaptable.  So enthusiastic and detailed!
